title: The vocabulary catalogue lists closed kernel members in their authored spelling
summary: The catalogue that `ia vocabulary` serves, the MCP door catalogue and the `vocabulary.md` reference listed the closed `@move` and `@primitive` members in lowercase (`synthesis`, `attention`). The language matches those members case-sensitively, so a `@system` registration that copied `move synthesis` from the catalogue was refused with `IA-LANG-DISCRIMINATOR-UNREGISTERED`. `kernelMembers` now lists `Delegation`, `Execution`, `Observation`, `Synthesis` and `Verification`, and `Attention`, `Decision`, `Escalation`, `Inference`, `Learning` and `Memory`, as the kernel spells them. No other catalogue field changes, and admission is unchanged. Migration: a consumer that compared `kernelMembers` against the lowercase names compares against the authored spelling.
